offline_level_b_checkpoints.summary: Offline fail-closed readiness gate for /odom and odom->base_link TF; result NOT_READY on current stationary evidence.

Hardening of the R1 readiness gate: fail-closed contract/candidate type validation, candidate-vs-contract coherence (covariance/IMU/dynamic contradictions), no mixed-channel publication, temporal-order check, adapter IMU reliability fix. Result unchanged: NOT_READY (same 11 blockers).

Closes remaining false-ready paths and declares the R1 series a non-publishable offline blocker-characterization gate: strict OdometryCandidate instance + full-structure validation, non-mapping adapter input fail-closed, contract string semantics (whitespace/allow-list/contradiction), covariance and dynamic flags always contradict (no covariance model, no typed dynamic-evidence object), and hard invariants odom/tf/nav2=false with publication_capability=WITHHELD_BY_R1_BOUNDARY. Result unchanged: NOT_READY (same 11 blockers). R2 must introduce versioned evidence models before publication is possible.

Closes residual exception paths on malformed input: report channels are derived from valid candidates only (no None/str sort TypeError on mixed valid/invalid sequences; fully-invalid sequence -> channels=()), broken iterables fail closed (except Exception, never BaseException), the adapter requires a strict collections.abc.Mapping with fail-closed protected field extraction (defective Mapping.get no longer propagates), and bool is rejected in every numeric component (position/velocity/rpy/quaternion/yaw_speed). R1 non-publishable boundary unchanged; current-fixture result unchanged: NOT_READY (same 11 blockers, publication_capability=WITHHELD_BY_R1_BOUNDARY).

Closes residual value-normalization paths inside an otherwise well-formed Mapping that R1C did not cover: imu_quaternion/imu_rpy are now required fields validated (shape, finiteness, non-zero quaternion norm) before any tuple() conversion instead of defaulting to a zero orientation or reaching tuple(True); stamp_sec/stamp_nanosec/receipt_wall_utc_ns are validated as non-negative non-bool integers instead of being silently defaulted or passed through unchecked; and bool is now rejected as a number in the adapter's own shared validation helpers (validation.py), not only in the readiness gate's private structural check. R1 non-publishable boundary unchanged; current-fixture result unchanged: NOT_READY (same 11 blockers, publication_capability=WITHHELD_BY_R1_BOUNDARY).

Closes the two reproducible defects an independent pre-push audit of R1D found. (1) _invalid() no longer stores a raw bool or an arbitrary object in a timestamp field: receipt_monotonic_ns/message_stamp_sec/message_stamp_nanosec/receipt_wall_utc_ns are normalized through is_nonnegative_int (bool-excluding) with canonical int/None fallbacks, so every invalid candidate stays well-typed and JSON-serializable. (2) A pathological imu_gyroscope/imu_accelerometer (e.g. a value whose __len__ or __iter__ raises) no longer invalidates the whole candidate: a single fail-closed classifier (_classify_imu_vector / _imu_reliability_and_warning, distinguishing MISSING/MALFORMED/NON_FINITE/ALL_ZERO/RELIABLE) degrades only that sensor's own reliability flag and warning. The function-wide except Exception this checkpoint previously relied on as a catch-all is removed in favor of these narrow, purpose-built helpers, so a genuine internal programming bug can no longer be silently converted into an invalid-candidate result. R1 non-publishable boundary unchanged; real-fixture result unchanged: NOT_READY (same 11 blockers, same 2 channels, publication_capability=WITHHELD_BY_R1_BOUNDARY).

Closes the four reproducible defects an independent pre-push audit of R1D-R1 found, all rooted in an untrusted source_channel. to_odometry_candidate now checks type(channel) is str before any in/== membership test (rejecting a hostile str subclass too, without ever touching its __eq__) with a fixed constant error message (never an f-string of channel, so a hostile __str__ can't raise either). _invalid() normalizes source_channel the same way it already normalizes timestamps: only an allowed channel of exact type str is preserved, anything else becomes the fixed sentinel _INVALID_SOURCE_CHANNEL = "<invalid>". validate_candidate_sequence() no longer trusts every candidate came from the adapter: it checks type(source_channel) is str before using it as a dict key, so a manually-constructed candidate with an unhashable channel can no longer crash it. models.py is unchanged. R1 non-publishable boundary unchanged; real-fixture result unchanged: NOT_READY (same 11 blockers, same 2 channels, publication_capability=WITHHELD_BY_R1_BOUNDARY).

Closes the three defects a GitHub-side independent audit of the published R1D-R2 commit found, without reinterpreting R1D-R2's own pre-push GO verdict. A new shared pure helper, normalize_finite_vector(), is now the only place position/velocity/imu_quaternion/imu_rpy's raw value is ever touched: it validates and canonicalizes in a single pass, closing the re-iteration that broke a sequence whose __iter__ only started raising on its second call. The shared numeric helpers (is_finite_number, is_positive_int, is_nonnegative_int) now gate on type(x) is int/float exactly instead of isinstance(), rejecting any hostile int/float subclass before its own comparison/conversion dunders ever run. The readiness gate's structural check (_is_structurally_valid_candidate) now reuses these same hardened shared helpers instead of duplicating its own numeric/vector logic, requires type(c) is OdometryCandidate exactly (rejecting a genuine subclass, not just a duck-typed fake) and type(source_channel) is str before the allow-list membership test; the structural-validation loop also wraps each per-candidate check in its own narrow except Exception (never BaseException) so an unexpected bug degrades only that one candidate instead of propagating out of the whole assessment. R1 non-publishable boundary unchanged; real-fixture result unchanged: NOT_READY (same 11 blockers, same 2 channels, publication_capability=WITHHELD_BY_R1_BOUNDARY).

Closes the three defects the R1D-R3 pre-push audit found plus three adjacent gaps in the same domain found during that same audit, without reinterpreting R1D-R3's NO_GO. A new pure helper, normalize_finite_number(), is the single definition of finite-number every other helper reuses: type(value) is int/float gates first, then float(value) is attempted inside a try that also catches OverflowError (alongside TypeError/ValueError) -- closing the real OverflowError math.isfinite() raised for an arbitrary-precision int (10**10000) in yaw_speed and every vector component. Two new constants, MAX_SIGNED_64 and MAX_MESSAGE_NANOSEC, bound the integer helpers (now is_bounded_positive_int/is_bounded_nonnegative_int) -- an internal storage/serialization limit only, not a resolution of ROS Time mapping or timestamp authority -- closing the json.dumps ValueError an unbounded timestamp integer produced. The readiness structural check now gates on type(...) is str before comparing timestamp_policy/frame_id/covariance_policy (matching source_channel's existing treatment), structurally validates receipt_wall_utc_ns for the first time, and _validate_contract() requires type(contract) is OdomTfEvidenceContract and type(value) is bool/str before any strip()/comparison, with an added narrow boundary in assess_odom_tf_readiness() around that call. test_malformed_candidate_never_raises_contract now asserts the full fail-closed outcome, not just the absence of an exception. R1 non-publishable boundary unchanged; real-fixture result unchanged: NOT_READY (same 11 blockers, same 2 channels, publication_capability=WITHHELD_BY_R1_BOUNDARY).

Defines deterministic fail-closed frame-semantics and covariance contracts with separate PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE, OFFLINE_REPLAY, SIMULATION and STRUCTURAL_ONLY contexts. Configured frame names are not physical verification. Preserved P1/P1A dispersion and residual quantities remain PARTIAL_QUANTIFIED in unresolved source units; no SI conversion or ROS covariance matrix is produced. Mapping inputs are read-only provenance and never promote historical or synthetic configuration to physical truth. Legacy activation and covariance placeholders can no longer imply publication readiness.

Adversarially audits P2 and hardens type, numeric, container, provenance, P1A, mapping, covariance-domain, readiness, replay and simulation-policy boundaries. Mapping evidence is now bound through a versioned manifest with verified source and origin-manifest hashes. The known preserved P1A artifact is quarantined by exact hash because its historical preferred analysis channel is non-null; mutated or synthetic non-null preference is rejected. No physical or simulated publication capability is introduced.
